电影感恐怖动作短片，开场即遭袭击，没有缓慢铺垫，写实实拍特效风格，最大程度动态运镜。场景：黄昏时分一条安静的郊区街道，一小群邻居聚集在各自家门外。低饱和真实调色，全程自然同期声，紧张配乐立即进入。
>
> **[0-1秒]** 硬切：一名男子从两栋房子之间踉跄走出，倒在街上，剧烈抽搐。
>
> **[1-2秒]** 附近的邻居冲向他施救，未察觉危险。
>
> **[2-3秒]** 他突然跃起，抓住最近之人的手臂。
>
> **[3-4秒]** 她尖叫着向后拉扯，而他的抓握牢牢不放，深色血管迅速蔓延过他的皮肤。
>
> **[4-5秒]** 他将她拉倒，人群在恐惧与困惑中四散。
>
> **[5-6秒]** 她在路面上剧烈抽搐，血管迅速蔓延过她的脖颈。
>
> **[6-7秒]** 几秒后她起身，双眼浑浊，加入他的行列，两人一同转向其他人。
>
> **[7-8秒]** 街道上爆发出响亮的恐惧尖叫，邻居们慌忙奔向各自家中。
>
> **[8-9秒]** 两名感染者快速移动，在前门附近抓住第三名邻居。
>
> **[9-10秒]** 他倒下，抽搐，片刻后作为他们中的一员起身。
>
> **[10-11秒]** 广角镜头：恐慌沿街道进一步蔓延，人们猛力关上门窗。
>
> **[11-12秒]** 一名男子从车库抓起一根棒球棍，谨慎地走出来。
>
> **[12-13秒]** 三名感染者转向他，快速穿过街道。
>
> **[13-14秒]** 他用力挥向第一个，结实的撞击将其击退到一辆停着的汽车上。
>
> **[14-15秒]** 一名邻居加入他，从附近院子抓起一把铁锹。
>
> **[15-16秒]** 慢动作插入镜头：她挥锹击中第二个感染者，将其击倒。
>
> **[16-17秒]** 第三个扑向持棒球棍的男子；他侧身闪避并再次击打。
>
> **[17-18秒]** 它踉跄着撞上邮箱倒下，仍试图起身。
>
> **[18-19秒]** 更多邻居谨慎现身，抓起园艺工具和临时武器。
>
> **[19-20秒]** 他们包围剩余的感染者，协同配合一起击打。
>
> **[20-21秒]** 慢动作：最后一击命中，三者全部瘫倒在街上一动不动。
>
> **[21-23秒]** 广角镜头：这群人站在他们上方，喘着粗气，武器仍高举。
>
> **[23-25秒]** 恐惧的喊叫逐渐平息，邻居们转为疲惫的宽慰。
>
> **[25-27秒]** 持棒球棍的男子缓缓放下球棍，扫视安静的街道，查看是否还有动静。
>
> **[27-29秒]** 邻居们互相查看，有人拥抱，有人震惊地坐在路缘上。
>
> **[29-30秒]** 最终镜头：街道在暮色天空下归于寂静，这群人站在一起，疲惫但安全。切至黑屏。
>
> 全程自然同期声——抽搐、尖叫、哭喊、金属撞击、沉重呼吸——叠加紧张的器乐配乐，在混乱中逐渐增强，结尾缓和为宽慰。无文字叠加，无水印。最大程度动态运镜变化——特写、广角、跟拍，慢动作仅保留给最后的击倒。仅在物理撞击时使用真实抖动，自然黄昏调色。

case-830.zh-Hans:
中国人能飞✈️

想飞吗？只需输入自己的照片，加上下面的提示词，你也能飞✈️😄

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

【风格】科幻史诗真人电影（Sci-fi Epic Live-Action），ARRI Alexa 35 机身 + Panavision Ultra Vintage 变形宽银幕镜头（Anamorphic），2.39:1 宽银幕画幅，Tiffen Black Pro-Mist 1/4 柔光镜，Kodak 250D 胶片质感、可见但细腻的颗粒，高光边缘带红橙渗色光晕（Halation），180°快门角自然运动模糊，暗部保留细节不死黑，8K超清，真实摄影（Photorealistic），无动漫感、无CG塑料感

【时长】30秒

【场景】从地球荒原一路上升，穿雷暴云 → 平流层 → 近地轨道 → 月球 → 小行星带 → 太阳表面

【角色】主角（全片同一人，服装与外形完全以参考图为准）

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：负手而立（85mm 长焦 / Slow Dolly In）

广角远景：主角@图片1背对镜头站在枯黄草原上，双手背在身后，一动不动。天顶被一整片巨大的乳状积云压满，远处地平线只有一条明亮的逆光带。

画面：风吹得草浪成片倒伏，逆光把草叶边缘描出一圈毛茸茸的金边。

机位：85mm 长焦压缩空间，镜头缓慢向前推进。

[00:02-00:04] 镜头2：起飞冲击（40mm / Speed Ramp + Whip Tilt Up）

0.3秒慢动作：主角@图片1脚下一圈环形冲击波贴地扩散出去，方圆几十米的草被压平成一个同心圆，碎草和沙尘垂直腾起。

随即切全速：他猛然垂直升空，画面只剩他的腿从上方出画。镜头急速上摇跟随，被气浪震了一下（Camera Shake），穿过尘土冲进云层。

[00:04-00:07] 镜头3：雷暴云中心（40mm）

主角@图片1缩成一个小黑点在云柱中垂直上升，负手姿态没有改变。四周云里的蓝白色闪电一道道炸开，每次闪把周围的云照亮一瞬，他的剪影在亮起的云幕上被压成一个黑点。

机位：跟随上升，云层向画面下方飞速倒退，变形镜头把画面边缘轻微拉长。

[00:07-00:09] 镜头4：冲出云顶（50mm / Backlit Emergence）

主角@图片1逆光穿出金色云层，身后的云被撞出一个漏斗形的空洞，暖金色光晕从他背后爆开。

画面：强逆光在他轮廓外缘烧出一圈红橙色渗色光晕（Halation），高光被柔光镜化开但不过曝。

[00:09-00:13] 镜头5：平流层360°环绕（50mm / Full 360° Orbit）

画面：主角@图片1在云海上方静止悬停，双手垂在身侧一动不动，全程不转身。天空上半部已是深棕黑的临近太空，下方是被夕阳染成金色的积云海。

机位（00:09-00:12）：50mm 镜头从他背后起，绕着他匀速环绕一整圈——依次经过他的侧面、正面、另一侧，最后转回他的背后。环绕全程机位与他的距离保持不变，他在画面里的大小也不变。

机位（00:12-00:13）：镜头停在他背后不动，他从这个背面视角猛然加速垂直上升，瞬间缩成一个小点飞离画面，只剩空荡荡的金色云海。

节奏：这一段要慢，是全片的呼吸点。

[00:13-00:15] 镜头6：地球轨道冲刺（40mm / Side Tracking + Vapor Cone）

硬切超近景：主角@图片1俯冲飞行姿态，身体水平前倾、手臂前伸，衣物被气流抽打得剧烈变形，布料褶皱清晰。背景是地球弧面和一整个台风漩涡云系。

特效：他身体周围炸开一圈白色音爆云环。

机位：侧后方跟拍，广角镜头把地球弧线拉得更弯，他向前飞离，两秒内缩成一个小黑点。

[00:15-00:17] 镜头7：奔月（40mm / Speed Trails + Star Streaks）

地球表面高速掠过化成放射状拉丝，切进黑色太空：主角@图片1拖出放射状速度线冲向远处的月球，背景的星星被拉成一道道细线。月球在画面中快速变大，冷白的月光在镜头里横向拉出一条蓝色变形光条。

[00:17-00:19] 镜头8：月面掠地（40mm / Low Skim）

主角@图片1从画面左侧入画，右侧是月球大特写，环形坑的边缘被侧光切出硬边。他俯冲向月面贴地极速掠行，月面从下方飞速倒退成放射状运动模糊，身后拉出一条长长的尘迹。

[00:19-00:21] 镜头9：落月（50mm / Impact + Dust Settle）

主角@图片1砸向月面，接触瞬间画面白闪一帧，一圈环形冲击波把月尘推出去铺成一张圆盘，镜头被震了一下。

尘埃在低重力下缓慢沉降后，他站在环形坑正中，双手垂在身侧一动不动，天上挂着一颗巨大的星球。

光：无大气散射的硬光，只有一个光源，影子内部纯黑没有任何补光。

机位：缓慢拉远并下摇。

[00:21-00:23] 镜头10：蹬地起飞（100mm 特写 → 广角 / Low-gravity Launch）

100mm 特写：主角@图片1的脚踩在布满裂缝的月壤上，投出一道又长又硬的黑影，浅景深把远处的坑壁化开。月壤颗粒质感清晰。

0.3秒慢动作后切全速：他猛然蹬地起飞，月尘炸成一根冲天的垂直喷射柱，柱体在低重力下缓慢向外扩散、久久不落。随后切太空：他的背影剪影在月球弧线上方，快速缩成一个光点。

[00:23-00:24] 镜头11：掠过橙色行星（85mm / Wide Pass）

切一颗橙黄色行星的弧面，厚大气层边缘泛出一圈辉光。主角@图片1化成一个小黑点从行星上方高速掠过，长焦压缩让行星显得巨大而人几乎看不见。

[00:24-00:27] 镜头12：撞穿小行星带（40mm / Behind-the-back Tracking）

画面：主角@图片1的背影锁在画面正中，身体前倾、双臂后掠，在密集的小行星之间高速穿梭、贴身擦过。几块小行星被撞碎，碎屑向四周甩出去。

机位：第三人称背后跟拍，镜头始终锁在他背后不动。小行星向画面两侧飞掠形成强烈的放射状运动模糊，变形镜头把边缘的岩块拉成长条，每次撞击镜头轻微震一下。

[00:27-00:29] 镜头13：太阳出现（40mm / Anamorphic Flare + Crash Zoom）

冲出小行星带，前方黑暗中出现一个带光晕的火点，横向的宽银幕镜头光晕贯穿整个画面。

机位：镜头急速推进，太阳在两秒内从一个点长到充满画面，边缘的日珥翻卷着甩出去。

[00:29-00:30] 镜头14：抵达（85mm / Continuous Push In）

主角@图片1的小剪影背对镜头，悬停在充满整个画面的太阳圆盘正中，只剩一个纯黑的轮廓。

光：过曝的橙白高光从他身体边缘溢出来，在轮廓外烧出一圈红橙渗色光晕，胶片颗粒在高光区变得明显。

机位：镜头持续推进直至定格。

音效：风吹草声 → 一记闷雷般的起跳冲击 → 雷暴轰鸣 → 破空声 → 真空静默（只剩低频轰鸣）→ 小行星碎裂的闷响 → 太阳表面的低频翻滚。
case-830.en:
Chinese people can fly ✈️

Want to fly? Just input your own photo, add the prompt below, and you can fly too ✈️😄

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

[Style] Sci-fi Epic Live-Action, ARRI Alexa 35 body + Panavision Ultra Vintage anamorphic lenses (Anamorphic), 2.39:1 widescreen aspect ratio, Tiffen Black Pro-Mist 1/4 diffusion filter, Kodak 250D film texture, visible but fine grain, red-orange halation on highlight edges (Halation), natural motion blur at 180° shutter angle, shadows retain detail without crushing to black, 8K ultra-clear, Photorealistic, no anime feel, no CG plastic feel

[Duration] 30 seconds

[Scene] Rising all the way from an Earth wasteland, passing through thunderstorm clouds → stratosphere → low Earth orbit → the Moon → asteroid belt → the surface of the Sun

[Character] Protagonist (the same person throughout the entire film; clothing and appearance strictly follow the reference image)

[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Standing with hands behind back (85mm telephoto / Slow Dolly In)

Wide long shot: the protagonist @图片1 stands with his back to the camera on a withered yellow grassland, hands behind his back, motionless. The zenith is completely covered by a huge sheet of mammatus cumulus clouds, and on the distant horizon there is only a bright band of backlight.

Image: the wind blows the grass waves down in sheets, and the backlight traces a fuzzy golden rim around the edges of the grass blades.

Camera position: 85mm telephoto compresses the space, and the camera slowly pushes forward.

[00:02-00:04] Shot 2: Takeoff impact (40mm / Speed Ramp + Whip Tilt Up)

0.3-second slow motion: a ring-shaped shockwave spreads out along the ground from beneath the protagonist @图片1's feet, flattening the grass within tens of meters into a concentric circle, while shredded grass and sand dust rise vertically.

Then cut to full speed: he suddenly rises vertically into the air, and only his legs remain in frame exiting from the top. The camera whips upward rapidly to follow, jolted by the air blast (Camera Shake), and rushes through the dust into the clouds.

[00:04-00:07] Shot 3: Center of the thunderstorm cloud (40mm)

The protagonist @图片1 shrinks into a small black dot rising vertically within the cloud column, his hands-behind-back posture unchanged. Blue-white lightning bolts explode one after another in the surrounding clouds, each flash illuminating the surrounding clouds for an instant, and his silhouette is pressed into a black dot against the lit cloud curtain.

Camera position: following the ascent, the clouds rapidly recede downward through the frame, and the anamorphic lens slightly stretches the edges of the frame.

[00:07-00:09] Shot 4: Breaking out of the cloud top (50mm / Backlit Emergence)

The protagonist @图片1 emerges backlit through the golden cloud layer, the clouds behind him punched into a funnel-shaped hole, and a warm golden halo bursts out from behind him.

Image: strong backlight burns a ring of red-orange halation around the outer edge of his silhouette, and the highlights are softened by the diffusion filter but not overexposed.

[00:09-00:13] Shot 5: Stratosphere 360° orbit (50mm / Full 360° Orbit)

Image: the protagonist @图片1 hovers motionless above the sea of clouds, hands hanging at his sides without moving, never turning around throughout. The upper half of the sky is already the deep brown-black of near space, while below is a sea of cumulus tinted golden by the setting sun.

Camera position (00:09-00:12): the 50mm lens starts from behind him and orbits uniformly around him for a full circle—passing in sequence his side, his front, his other side, and finally returning to behind him. Throughout the orbit the camera distance from him remains constant, and his size in frame also remains constant.

Camera position (00:12-00:13): the camera stops behind him and holds still, and from this rear view he suddenly accelerates vertically upward, instantly shrinking to a small dot and flying out of frame, leaving only the empty golden sea of clouds.

Rhythm: this section should be slow; it is the breathing point of the entire film.

[00:13-00:15] Shot 6: Earth orbit dash (40mm / Side Tracking + Vapor Cone)

Hard cut to extreme close shot: the protagonist @图片1 in a diving flight posture, body leaning horizontally forward, arms extended forward, clothing violently deformed by the air current, fabric folds clearly visible. The background is the Earth's curved surface and an entire typhoon vortex cloud system.

VFX: a ring of white vapor cone bursts around his body.

Camera position: tracking from the rear side, the wide-angle lens bends the Earth's arc even more, and he flies forward away, shrinking to a small black dot within two seconds.

[00:15-00:17] Shot 7: Rushing to the Moon (40mm / Speed Trails + Star Streaks)

The Earth's surface streaks past at high speed into radial trails, cutting into black space: the protagonist @图片1 drags radial speed lines rushing toward the distant Moon, and the stars in the background are stretched into thin lines. The Moon rapidly grows larger in frame, and the cold white moonlight is stretched horizontally across the lens into a blue anamorphic light streak.

[00:17-00:19] Shot 8: Lunar surface skim (40mm / Low Skim)

The protagonist @图片1 enters frame from the left side, with a large close-up of the Moon on the right, the edges of craters cut into hard edges by side light. He dives toward the lunar surface and skims at extreme speed close to the ground, the lunar surface rapidly receding below into radial motion blur, dragging a long dust trail behind him.

[00:19-00:21] Shot 9: Landing on the Moon (50mm / Impact + Dust Settle)

The protagonist @图片1 slams into the lunar surface; at the moment of contact the frame flashes white for one frame, a ring-shaped shockwave pushes the lunar dust outward into a disk, and the camera is jolted.

After the dust slowly settles under low gravity, he stands in the center of the crater, hands hanging at his sides without moving, and a giant planet hangs in the sky.

Light: hard light with no atmospheric scattering, only one light source, and the interior of the shadow is pure black with no fill light at all.

Camera position: slowly pull back and tilt down.

[00:21-00:23] Shot 10: Push-off launch (100mm close-up → wide angle / Low-gravity Launch)

100mm close-up: the protagonist @图片1's foot steps on the cracked lunar regolith, casting a long hard black shadow, and the shallow depth of field blurs the distant crater wall. The texture of the lunar regolith grains is clear.

After 0.3 seconds of slow motion, cut to full speed: he suddenly pushes off the ground and launches, the lunar dust exploding into a vertical jet column shooting skyward, the column slowly spreading outward under low gravity and not falling for a long time. Then cut to space: his back silhouette above the lunar arc, rapidly shrinking into a point of light.

[00:23-00:24] Shot 11: Passing an orange planet (85mm / Wide Pass)

Cut to the curved surface of an orange-yellow planet, with a ring of glow at the edge of its thick atmosphere. The protagonist @图片1 turns into a small black dot passing at high speed above the planet, and the telephoto compression makes the planet appear enormous while the person is almost invisible.

[00:24-00:27] Shot 12: Smashing through the asteroid belt (40mm / Behind-the-back Tracking)

Image: the protagonist @图片1's back is locked in the center of the frame, body leaning forward, arms swept back, weaving at high speed among dense asteroids and brushing past them at close range. Several asteroids are shattered by impact, and debris is flung outward in all directions.

Camera position: third-person tracking from behind, the camera always locked behind him without moving. Asteroids sweep past both sides of the frame forming strong radial motion blur, the anamorphic lens stretches the rocks at the edges into long streaks, and the camera jolts slightly with each impact.

[00:27-00:29] Shot 13: The Sun appears (40mm / Anamorphic Flare + Crash Zoom)

Bursting out of the asteroid belt, a fiery point with a halo appears in the darkness ahead, and a horizontal widescreen lens flare runs across the entire frame.

Camera position: the camera pushes in rapidly, and the Sun grows from a point to filling the frame within two seconds, with prominences at its edge rolling and flinging outward.

[00:29-00:30] Shot 14: Arrival (85mm / Continuous Push In)

The protagonist @图片1's small silhouette, back to the camera, hovers at the exact center of the solar disk that fills the entire frame, leaving only a pure black outline.

Light: overexposed orange-white highlights spill out from the edges of his body, burning a ring of red-orange halation outside the silhouette, and the film grain becomes pronounced in the highlight areas.

Camera position: the camera continues to push in until it freezes.

Sound effects: wind blowing through grass → a muffled thunder-like takeoff impact → thunderstorm rumble → whoosh through the air → vacuum silence (only a low-frequency rumble remains) → the muffled thud of asteroids shattering → the low-frequency churning of the Sun's surface.

extra-7989eb18eb6c.zh-Hans:
使用 seedance 2.5 制作

提示词 👇 
创作一部可爱、电影感的3D动画短片，主角是一只可爱的毛茸茸小企鹅女孩，拥有柔软的灰白羽毛、巨大而富有表现力的蓝色眼睛、小小的黑色喙、圆胖的身体、小小的黑色脚丫，头上戴着一个粉色小蝴蝶结。

场景1——开始：
小企鹅独自站在温暖舒适家中的彩色条纹地毯上。她看起来有些害羞天真，轻轻转动头部环顾四周。采用竖屏9:16构图，柔和温暖的室内灯光，浅景深，细致的毛茸茸羽毛，电影感运镜。

场景2——可爱特写：
镜头缓慢推向她的脸。她直视镜头，巨大的眼睛闪闪发光，然后开心地微笑并张开小喙。捕捉可爱的面部表情和细微的羽毛运动。

场景3——情绪转变：
她的表情突然变得严肃而坚定。她压低身体贴近地面，眯起眼睛，微微展开小翅膀，准备像一个小小的愤怒超级英雄一样向前跳跃。保持低机位和电影感。

场景4——跳跃：
